svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 12 resources (7 spatial cards, 5 logical resources in 1 group cards) · 17 relationships Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified. Spatial card role marks: rounded rectangle = execution; cylinder = data store; hexagon = network.

g.text: 12 resources (7 spatial cards, 5 logical resources in 1 group cards) · 17 relationships
Line color shows the relationship's own Terraform action, independently of endpoint-card actions.
no independent change: no separate Terraform action is identified. unchanged: an explicit no-op action.
Dashed line from a Route to its
Hollow circles mark resource/card attachment points; neither end of an undirected line is a directional start.
Filled internal dots mark bundle junctions.
Matching [N] badges identify the same Terraform-backed relationship and its Relationship Resources entry. They do
not express direction or count connections. Reference-only Connections and Dependencies have no number.
